title: ProcessRuntimeAdapter
responsibility: Runs a native unit as a one-shot or persistent JSON process behind the runtime contract.

inputs.name: ProcessRuntimeAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: The process configuration supplies the required executable and optional arguments, persistence mode, and timeout. Missing args becomes [], missing timeoutMs uses 30000 ms, and persistent mode keeps one child for line exchanges.

inputs.name: ProcessRuntimeAdapter.invoke.request
inputs.description: A runtime request contains a required operation string and optional input payload. invoke forwards it only when it is portable JSON: finite numbers, well-formed strings, plain objects and arrays, with at most 64 nested object or array levels.

inputs.name: ProcessRuntimeAdapter.invokeText.text
inputs.description: Raw text sent to the child process. Persistent mode writes it as one line after replacing embedded newlines with spaces; one-shot mode writes the text as provided.

outputs.name: ProcessRuntimeAdapter.invoke
outputs.description: Resolves to a RuntimeResponse success envelope or failure envelope. Non-portable requests, invalid response text, process startup or exit failures, and timeouts are returned as failure responses.

outputs.name: ProcessRuntimeAdapter.invokeText
outputs.description: Resolves to the child’s stdout text unchanged, or JSON text encoding a failure response. A persistent exchange returns its next line, while one-shot mode returns all captured stdout.

outputs.name: ProcessRuntimeAdapter.close
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after requesting termination of the persistent child, if one exists. It has no process to close in one-shot mode.
